title: The ALMA Frontier Fields Survey. I. 1.1 mm continuum detections in Abell 2744, MACS J0416.1-2403 and MACS J1149.5+2223
question: Can ALMA 1.1 mm mosaics of three Frontier Fields lensing clusters detect sub-mJy dusty star-forming galaxies, and what are their fluxes, sizes and NIR counterpart offsets?

what.value: Lens models for magnification from FF archive teams

evidence.quote: We estimate the magnification values as in (cite: Coe2015), by taking the 16th, 50th and 84th percentiles of the magnification values given by the full range from all the models

what.value: Comparison samples of sizes/fluxes (SMA, SDP.81, UDS, HerMES)

evidence.quote: objects from the UKIDSS ultra deep survey (UDS) part of the SCUBA-2 cosmology legacy survey and the un-lensed objects from the *Herschel* Multi-tiered Extragalactic Survey (HerMES)

what.value: Source number density >0.084 mJy used for confusion estimate

evidence.quote: We should expect a number density of $\approx10^{4.8}\,\,{\rm deg}^{-2}$ sources with flux densities $>0.084$ mJy (cite: Fujimoto2016).

recipe.method: JAO-based reduction, edge channels reinstated, natural-weighted mfs mosaic CLEAN
sigma-clip rms in PB>=0.5, S/N>=5 pixels grouped with DBSCAN, 2D Gaussian fits; purity from simobserve simulations and NIR counterparts

recipe.goal: measure flux densities and sizes in uv-plane
recipe.method: uvmcmcfit elliptical Gaussian in uv-plane after PB-weighting pointings within 19''
assumptions: no magnification modeled in the fit (lensed image plane)

recipe.method: magnification from 16/50/84th percentiles of FF lens models; r/sqrt(mu), F/mu
assumptions: z=2 (range 1-3) for sources without spectroscopic redshift

recipe.method: 2D Gaussian centroid of F160W counterpart vs ALMA; source plane offsets via Zitrin-NFWv3 and LTMv1

evidence.quote: We detect 12 dusty star-forming galaxies at $S/N\geq5.0$ across the three clusters
The best-fit regression values are $m=-0.08\pm0.10$ and $b=-0.95\pm0.05$
